title: Financial Management
description: Provides a foundation in public sector financial management, focused on the needs of government managers. Topics include: government financial statements and their analysis; public sector accounting standards and financial reporting; operational and capital budgeting; public sector financial management; cost management and control; accountability and performance measurement. Covers all levels of government in Canada: municipal; provincial and federal. Familiarity with the use of Microsoft Excel required.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ADMN 421, ADMN 448.
